decision.title: Decision
decision.kycFirst: The shop can go live once the owner's identity check has passed.
decision.approveBody: It appears in search at once, in every emirate where search is open. The seller is told.
decision.rejectBody: The seller reads your reason, can fix the shop and send it again.
decision.suspendBody: It leaves search and its page closes at once. The seller reads your reason.
decision.reinstateBody: It appears in search again at once.
